notes: Three theorems proved; added one helper lemma card_torsion_cyc_aux (generic cyclic bound). Odd prime power case was a direct hit: search returned ZMod.isCyclic_units_of_prime_pow and IsCyclic.card_pow_eq_one_le at rank 1. The key find was ZMod.isCyclic_units_two_pow_quotient_neg_one (text_search rank 2, which I would not have recalled): units mod 2^e modulo <-1> is cyclic, giving the <=4 bound via fibers of size 2 over at most 2 square-roots-of-1 in the cyclic quotient. The premises tool ranked generic group lemmas (orderOf_dvd_card at 7, orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one at 1) but did not surface the specific cyclic-units lemmas; search/text_search did. Remaining work (fiber counting, e=0 edge, totient) was plain Lean.
